description:
Kick off a video export of the project. Returns immediately with an export_id;
the export renders in the background and takes ~5 min. Call get_export(export_id,
wait_seconds=55) until status is completed — it then returns download_url. The export
also appears in the Exports tab in the editor.

Defaults: 1080p / 30fps / no captions / English. Pass overrides only when needed.

captions.description: Burn subtitles into the video (default false)

name: export_project
title: Export project
